ops.new: FINAL REQUIREMENT PROPOSED (DERIVED, linear, on the V5c structure (CAD v3.3), at the ASSUMED J 1.6e-3 kg m2 (servo output shaft, reflected by g = n^2 at the centre and added to the engine inertia), cons kinematics and first bending 24.3 Hz full / 25.64 Hz landing): (1) design-to window for the servo output stiffness 100 <= K_s <= 130 N m/rad (two-sided; the only contiguous window that passes ENG-07d on every floor20 corner on the continuous pose envelope between the 9 V5c poses; margins 0.03-0.28 dB above 6 dB; conditional on the plant, see the RV6-14 sentence); (2) acceptance: ENG-07d (stable, upper GM >= 6 dB at every floor20 corner, continuous pose envelope, notch as flown) re-run on the B-TVC-1 measured K_s (with its measurement uncertainty), J and reflected-inertia convention and rocking modes at the poses, and on the measured or airframe-FE first bending mode (full and landing); K_s is frozen only on a PASS; on a FAIL the notch set (second notch on the measured bending mode) is changed and the margins re-run before any K_s change. The 9-pose passes at 190 and 220-230 N m/rad are WITHDRAWN (pose sampling); 250-270 N m/rad pass on both axes but are not a design-to value. ops.anchor: At the ASSUMED bending mode, K_s 100-130 N m/rad is the window to design to.
ops.new: The window is computed on the V5c structure (CAD v3.3). The 3D FE of CAD v3.5.1 (CHANGELOG 221; SIM, coarsened-model modes, production-model K) agrees with the ENG-11 plant on the engine inertia (0.0585 / 0.0590 vs I_piv 0.0588-0.0594 kg m2) and on the kinematic factor (23.04). It leaves the servo rotor out: J 1.6e-3 kg m2 is servo-side, 0.0369 kg m2 at the pivot, added to the engine inertia, so the loop's rocking frequency is 0.786 x the FE's 21-33 Hz. The FE structure is stiffer: neutral K 7284 / 5370 against V5c centre 6539 / 4325 N m/rad. On that structure, at nominal J, the full-tank rocking range reaches the coincidence band (24.1-24.7 Hz at the nominal bending) at K_s about 126 (alpha) / 129 (beta) N m/rad (DERIVED frequency map; uniform pose scaling ASSUMED). At J 0.76e-3 the whole window is exposed. GNC re-verifies the window before it is quoted as design-to.

J convention (lead 227 (2); REV-GNC-6 [12] FE plant check (1)): J (1.6e-3 kg m2, range 0.76-2.7e-3) is the servo rotor and gear-train inertia at the servo output shaft (SB-2292SG DATASHEET-derived, ASSUMED) and is ADDED to the engine inertia I_piv; the FE engine inertia 0.0585 / 0.0590 kg m2 matches I_piv 0.0588-0.0594 within 1.6 %, and the FE does not inform J. The convention is VERIFIED (code and source data); the value of J stays TO-VERIFY at B-TVC-1. LEAD (227 (3)): Design-to window 100 <= K_s <= 130 N m/rad (two-sided) on the V5c plant (CAD v3.3) at the ASSUMED J, cons kinematics and bending 24.3 / 25.64 Hz. Acceptance is the ENG-07d re-run on the B-TVC-1 measured K_s, J, convention and rocking modes and on the measured or airframe-FE bending mode, and K_s is frozen only on a PASS. The 9-pose passes at 190 and 220-230 are WITHDRAWN. On the 3D FE structure (stiffer: neutral 7284 / 5370 against V5c 6539 / 4325 N m/rad) the top of the window falls to about 126 (alpha) / 129 (beta) N m/rad (DERIVED frequency map, uniform pose scaling ASSUMED). GNC re-verifies the window on the FE plant (RV6-14 re-run (a)-(e)) before the datasheet quotes it as design-to; until then the datasheet quotes it with its plant basis. gnc.json airframe_first_bending_min_Hz 10 Hz (goal 15) is recorded NOT CONSISTENT with ENG-07d at this window with one fixed notch: 10-22 Hz fail on at least one axis, 24.3-30 Hz pass (DERIVED). This is an open item for the airframe work (line 222); the engine-side remedy (second notch on the measured bending mode) stays a GNC study. The RV6-14 re-run (a)-(e) is staged apart for the reviewer's delta check (01-systems-gnc/staging_v3.1/rev4b/eng11_fe/) and is not folded into this text.

ops.new: Nominal flights (mon2): false GIMBAL_FAULT aborts 0/1000 (UB95 0.30 %); nominal metric max 0.18-0.19 deg vs 1.5 deg with the flexible mount and encoder quantisation modelled; encoder noise, vibration and supply sag not modelled.

ops.old: whether to inhibit the GIMBAL_FAULT abort near touchdown is a safety decision for the lead (a jammed engine at up to ~20 deg may leave the range safety envelope) and is not proposed here.
ops.new: whether to inhibit the GIMBAL_FAULT abort near touchdown was put to the lead as a safety decision (a jammed engine at up to ~20 deg may leave the range safety envelope); it is DECIDED: NOT inhibited (227 (7), below).

LEAD SAFETY DECISION (227 (7)): RE-24, lead safety decision: the GIMBAL_FAULT abort is NOT inhibited near touchdown; a detected landing-burn jam aborts as designed. Why: continuing gains landing P 0.136-0.150 against 0.084-0.088 only inside a failure whose rate is unknown; a thrust cut gives a more predictable impact point than a lit engine held at a jammed angle; and an inhibit adds a mode to verify. Revisit if B-TVC-1 gives a jam rate. The undetected-jam result carries the RV6-06 scope (31 runs per base and servo, all late jams, 0 lost / 0 gained, one-sided UB95 9.2 % per arm); 0/1000 false aborts (UB95 0.30 %; encoder noise, vibration and supply sag not modelled).

ops.old: Proposal: re-initialise the mode-3 filter at the Pc-invalid onset (or start counting at onset + 3 tau) and re-run the R2 v2 statistics after Electronics' S17 sweep (onsets 1-50 ms x frame phases x noise).
ops.new: ADOPTED as a flight-software requirement (lead 227 (6), the first option of the rev4 proposal): the mode-3 filter is re-initialised at the Pc-invalid onset; Electronics implements it in v2.11 and runs S17 (onsets 1-50 ms x frame phases x noise); GNC re-runs the R2 v2 statistics with the flush afterwards (the alternative, counting from onset + 3 tau, is not adopted).

ops.old: Back-of-envelope (DERIVED, independent frames ASSUMED): 5 N rms frame noise raises the window maximum of the 3-frame minimum by about +4 N (median) to +8 N (p99) over 50 frames, which is the whole +5.3 to +6.0 N W10 < 6 margin, so a frame-noise budget is needed before the 'no released dead vehicle' claim is used.
ops.new: Frame noise (DERIVED; REV-GNC-6 Monte Carlo under these assumptions, RV6-07): 5 N rms frame noise (iid ASSUMED) raises the window maximum of the 3-frame minimum by +3.1 N median / +7.8 N p99 over 50 frames (0.5 s) and +3.8 / +8.2 N over 80 frames (0.8 s). Against the R2 v2 mode-3 margins at W10 < 6 (+5.98 N at 0.5 s, +5.30 N at 0.8 s) the bounding run would be released with probability 6.5 % / 18.4 %; against the v3.1 R2 margin (16.31 N = 37.16 - 20.85 N) the probability is about 0. LEAD (227 (6)): Electronics states the FC frame-noise budget against the +5.3 to +6.0 N mode-3 margin; the 'no released dead vehicle' claim is used only with that budget.
